name: UNSW Law Disability Support Scholarship
summary: Yearly scholarship for UNSW Law and Justice students with a long-term medical condition or disability who are in financial need.
key: $5,000 per annum for minimum program duration.
who: Undergraduate or postgraduate student in the Faculty of Law and Justice
how: Apply through UAC for an Equity Scholarship (ES)
catches: 2027 rounds: EAS via UAC by 19 Nov 2026, ES by 10 Dec 2026, with later January and February rounds; offers made through to March 2027
Competitive; meeting the criteria does not guarantee an award

source.label: UNSW Scholarships: UNSW Equity Scholarships for 2027

evidence.quote: Supports the Faculty of Law and Justice students with a long-term medical condition or disability
